what: Sprawl Override audit omits the full append-tool-failure.sh contract
scenario_or_breakage: On Override, prose only says append a Warnings entry; append-tool-failure.sh requires --log, --site, --tool, --exit-code, --category, and --output-file (file must exist). A minimal implementation can skip the write or call the helper without a log file and get exit 2; audit is lost despite || true
suggested_fix: Mirror the existing plan-command Override pattern in skills/design/SKILL.md (~1401): write $DESIGN_TMPDIR/operator-override-sprawl.log first, then append with --site design Step 1c sprawl heuristic or design Step 1d sprawl heuristic, --tool operator-override-sprawl, --exit-code 0, --category Warnings, --redact
